body.p: A transformation cannot ask you to confirm a tool call. A tool that would ask for your confirmation in the chat, such as an MCP tool, a command line, or a tool contributed by a plugin, runs only if it is always allowed in the Unsafe tool auto-approval preferences page. Otherwise, the AI receives a refusal that names the entry to add, such as plugin:term_check_current_document safe-calls, and the refusal is logged.
